# On and off by default — the `html` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#html).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** an HTML file.
- **Rules:** 85 — 0 on, 64 on with `preview = true`, 10 off in an opt-in preset, 11 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `html/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 64 | 64 error | html-validate 11.16.4 recommended, without its layout rules and the cosmetic rules its prettier and browser presets switch off, reimplemented |
| `html/a11y` | no — opt in | 26 | 26 error | html-validate 11.16.4 a11y: the accessibility rules and WCAG techniques, reimplemented |
| `html/document` | no — opt in | 5 | 5 error | html-validate 11.16.4 document: checks that only make sense for a complete page, reimplemented |
| `html/conventions` | no — opt in | 3 | 3 error | Opt-in house conventions: target=_blank needs rel=noopener, and no inline style or script |
| `html/security` | no — opt in | 5 | 5 error | the html pack's security rules: subresource integrity, reverse tabnabbing, inline scripts, password autocomplete, meta refresh |
| `html/size` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 error | Size limits for pages and templates, opt-in: a line limit per file |
| `html/markers` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 error | TODO comments with a ticket (and a date when asked) |
